outcome: A replacement remote environment can be prepared from the project profile without losing uncommitted work, and an interrupted Story delivery run can resume there without repeating a completed step
acceptance: a caller lists local and replacement environment fleet slots
a replacement environment is prepared from the same profile
uncommitted work is copied onto the replacement environment
uncommitted work that would be discarded is reported and blocks until loss is accepted
an interrupted Story delivery run resumes on the replacement environment without re-running a completed Planner step
a failed prerequisite on the replacement still leaves it not ready
secrets are not persisted in fleet records
inScope: Story delivery resume after environment replacement
assumptions: a remote fleet slot is a replacement workspace prepared from the same profile
uncommitted work is workspace files other than node_modules and .git
retained HuntianLing artifacts under .huntianling move with the replacement
